title: Audit + test: JMAP method authorization against RFC 8621
description:
Static review could not verify per-method authorization checks in the mail crate against RFC 8621 requirements. RFC 8621 specifies that each method must check the authenticated principal has the required rights before operating.

Step 1 — Audit (read, no code change):
For each of these methods in mail/src/, identify what authorization check (if any) is present:
- Email/get (§5.1): must check mailbox read rights
- Email/set (§5.3): must check mailbox write rights for create/update/destroy
- Mailbox/set (§2.5): must check account ownership or admin rights for create/destroy

Step 2 — File sub-issues for any missing checks found.

Step 3 — Write tests:
For each method, write a test that:
1. Authenticates as user A
2. Attempts to access or modify a resource owned by user B
3. Asserts the response is a method-level error (forbidden), not a server error and not a silent success

Independent oracle: RFC 8621 §2-§5 defines the exact error types (forbidden, invalidArguments, etc.) and conditions.
